performance.core: deterministic in-browser classification over a small user-managed step list
performance.knownScalingBoundary: No claim is made that the current React-state workflow is appropriate for very large enterprise process maps without profiling and persistence architecture.

resilience.offlineClaim: No PWA/offline-install claim is made, but core classification does not require an external service after the page loads.
resilience.failureMode: If export is blocked by browser download policy, the visible classification remains available in the page; no remote state is lost because no remote state exists.
resilience.reset: RESET / START OVER restores the demonstration workflow.
